text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] outbound auth-proxy returning 502/503 to hosted API traffic in eu-central. Elevated error rate and user-facing failures since ~09:12 UTC. Paging ops-oncall, SRE rotation, and eng-platform.

ops-oncall: ack. Seeing proxy pod restarts and a jump in `proxy_pool` 5xxs. CPU on a subset of pods at 95% and large number of `recv` socket errors.

alex_sre: I'll take the lead. Pulling logs now. Any recent deploys to proxy?

jenna_eng: we rolled nginx v1.21.3 to the proxy pool at 09:05 UTC as part of the platform base-image update. Also changed env `KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=5s` to try to free connections faster for new workloads.

tom_cs: multiple affected customers pinged support. One enterprise customer had sustained 502s during a 10m ingestion window. They want a status link and ETA.

ops-oncall: starting a rolling restart of the proxy replica set to cycle pods and pick up any transient state; will start with 3 canary pods.

alex_sre: quick grep shows repeated pattern in proxy logs:

```
2026-03-15T09:12:24Z proxy-8f7c: warn: TLS handshake error: no shared cipher with backend 10.34.5.2:443
2026-03-15T09:12:24Z proxy-8f7c: error: recv: connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T09:12:25Z proxy-8f7c: upstream returned 502 for request id=abcd-1234
```

sam_infra: backend service still on OpenSSL 1.0.2 and supports older ciphers; nginx 1.21 default cipher list looks more modern. Could be a negotiation mismatch causing repeated renegotiation and CPU churn.

jenna_eng: confirmed we updated the default `ssl_ciphers` when building the nginx package. Rolling back the cipher list to include the legacy set might stop the handshakes. Also the aggressive `KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=5s` was likely closing client sockets causing extra reconnections.

ops-oncall: applying config change to canary pods: restore `KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=75s` and revert `ssl_ciphers` to the previous platform list. Patching canary now.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: ops-oncall -> alex_sre in 10m for root-cause verification and timeline prep.

ops-oncall: canary patched at 09:22 UTC. Observed canary metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 0.6%, CPU back to ~40% on patched pods. Rolling to remaining pods now.

jenna_eng: opening a PR to pin the nginx package and include an explicit `ssl_ciphers` block for backward compatibility. Also will remove the 5s keepalive change from the platform config.

alex_sre: collecting traces to compute incident window and failed request ids. Found first failed trace at 09:12:19 and last at 09:26:48 on eu-central. I'll round the customer-facing window to 09:129:27 UTC.

tom_cs: drafting status page copy and short customer email. Posting drafts below, please edit.

--- status page draft ---
We experienced elevated 5xx errors for API traffic served from eu-central between 09:12 and 09:27 UTC due to proxy TLS negotiation failures after a platform image update. Engineers reverted the configuration and rolled a fix; service performance has returned to normal. A detailed incident summary with corrective actions will be published within 72 hours.

--- customer email draft ---
Hi team,

We observed intermittent 502/503 errors impacting API calls routed through eu-central between 09:12 and 09:27 UTC. The root cause was a platform proxy configuration and TLS cipher change deployed earlier in the maintenance window, which caused frequent TLS renegotiation with some backend hosts. We have reverted the configuration and rolled the fix; service is stable. We're preparing a detailed incident report and corrective actions and will follow up within 72 hours.

Please let us know if you saw data loss or need a deeper runbook review.

Best,
Redwood Support

--- end drafts ---

legal: please avoid any wording that suggests automatic service credits. Keep it factual. Also avoid phrasing that could be interpreted as admitting data loss unless confirmed.

product_pm: add action item to notify customers running long-lived uploads or streaming sessions; they may have to retry partial uploads.

alex_sre: proposed action items in-thread:
- Immediate: revert platform `ssl_ciphers` and `KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT` on proxy pool (done).
- Short-term (48h): add TLS compatibility preflight to the base-image rollout job that runs handshake tests against a sample of backend hosts.
- Short-term (48h): add synthetic canary traffic that exercises TLS handshakes and measures handshake latency and failure rate during image rollouts.
- Medium-term (2w): extend rollout gating to include TLS and socket error metrics (auto-pause on >1% 5xx increase or TLS error spikes).
- Medium-term (2w): pin nginx package for platform builds until cipher migration plan is completed.

sam_infra: I'll own the preflight script and synthetic canary work; assigning ETA 48h.

jenna_eng: I'll own the package pin and PR to platform build; ETA 1 business day.

ops-oncall: opening incident ticket and action items: INC-20260315-073. Will attach logs and the steps taken.

alex_sre: timeline confirmation for the RCA: first anomalous trace 09:12:19 UTC, canary patch applied 09:22:00 UTC, error volume returned to baseline by ~09:259:27 UTC. Good to present as 09:129:27 UTC window.

tom_cs: publishing status page update now and sending the short customer email to affected accounts. Will include link to incident ticket and note that a full RCA will be delivered in 72 hours.

legal: ack on wording note.

ops-oncall: final: rolling restart completed at 09:31 UTC and cluster health checks passed. Leaving owner tags: sam_infra for preflight and synthetic tests, jenna_eng for package pin, alex_sre for RCA and timeline, tom_cs for customer comms. We'll reconvene tomorrow to review the full RCA draft. :thumbsup:
